title: Pill → bathroom
text:
CONTEXT:
Sophie is a patient in a psychiatric hospital. She is in a meeting with the doctor and the doctor’s assistant. The assistant is a businesslike woman who habitually carries a clipboard.

SHOOT THIS:
It is a 5miligram pill. it is purple. she takes it from the cup, then puts it under her tongue.

she walks out of the doctor meeting

in the bathroom, everything is getting hot, and it is very loud

(shugachink) a high pitched screeching sound, then gone. she looks up, and a wave of black threatens to overwhelm her, like a seam, opening up in the sky.

END HERE:
Sophie is still conscious, sitting in the bathroom, but realizes something is seriously wrong.

DO NOT SHOOT:
Do not show her getting up, leaving the bathroom, seeing the assistant, or fainting.

title: Bathroom → faint
text:
WHAT CAME BEFORE — DO NOT SHOOT:
Sophie was given a 5miligram purple pill during a meeting with her doctor and the doctor’s assistant. She put it under her tongue and left. In the bathroom, she suddenly became extremely hot. Everything sounded loud. She heard a high pitched screeching sound and a wave of black threatened to overwhelm her vision, like a seam opening up in the sky.

SHOOT THIS:
she is shaky as she gets up from the toilet

ringing noise intensifies.

she gets up from the toilet, and starts to walk out of the bathroom, the light glaring down at her, things become blurry, and go back to normal a couple of times.

she makes it outside the bathroom, and puts her palm against the wall, gripping, to keep herself steady

from about 20 feet away, the assistant is walking towards her, holding her clipboard as always, very business like.

when she sees sophie there, she starts to walk a little faster, with only a touch of alarm

“i think im about to faint,” says sophie, shrilly, her voice weak, but gathering momentum as she speaks

then she does faint, and her body slides down against the wall, there’s a hum that gathers into a crescendo, then everything is black

END HERE:
Complete blackness.

IMPORTANT:
The assistant does not panic or run. Her alarm is subtle. Sophie’s faint should happen naturally and suddenly, with her body sliding down the wall rather than dramatically throwing herself to the floor.

title: Floor → office
text:
WHAT CAME BEFORE — DO NOT SHOOT:
Sophie staggered out of the bathroom, braced herself against the hallway wall and told the approaching assistant, “i think im about to faint.” She then fainted, sliding down the wall. Everything went black.

SHOOT THIS:
from the floor, eyes opening and closing, head still ringing slightly, things are a bit blurry, and the light feels hot from where she is

“sophie!” says the assistant, slightly more alarmed now

they walk back to the office together, and sit across from the doctor again.

END HERE:
Sophie and the assistant are seated across from the same doctor from the earlier meeting.

IMPORTANT:
Sophie has only just regained consciousness. Do not make her suddenly look completely normal during the walk back.

title: “Were you straining?”
text:
WHAT CAME BEFORE — DO NOT SHOOT:
Sophie was given a purple pill, became suddenly hot and dizzy in the bathroom, fainted in the hallway, and regained consciousness on the floor. The assistant has now brought her back to the doctor’s office. Sophie and the assistant are sitting across from the doctor again.

SHOOT THIS:
“i was just sitting on the toilet, and then, i don’t know, i just all of a sudden felt like i was gonna faint!” she talks in a rush. “i’ve never fainted before but…”

the assistant interrupts her

“were you straining?” asks the assistant, nodding, and wrinkling her nose, as if she is being understanding

END HERE:
Stay in the office immediately after the assistant asks the question.

IMPORTANT:
The assistant genuinely thinks she is asking a reasonable medical question. She is not joking or deliberately humiliating Sophie. That sincerity is what makes the moment strange.

title: “No, i —”
text:
WHAT CAME BEFORE — DO NOT SHOOT:
After Sophie fainted, the assistant brought her back to the doctor’s office. Sophie tried to explain that she had suddenly felt like she was going to faint while sitting on the toilet. The assistant interrupted her and, with an understanding expression, asked, “were you straining?”

SHOOT THIS:
“no, i -” sophie stops talking. insane. she feels insane. she doesn’t know what to do. she looks from the assistant, to the doctor, and back again

END HERE:
Hold on Sophie.

IMPORTANT:
No one says anything else. Sophie does not explain herself. The doctor and assistant do not react dramatically. The awkwardness comes from how ordinary they are behaving while Sophie feels completely bewildered.
